name: Czerka Attenuating Pulsator
prerequisite: The ability to cast tech powers
description: When you score a critical hit or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a ranged attack using this weapon, you can regain a number of tech points equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of one, no action required).  Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or long rest before you can use it again.
